question.problem:
| $x$ | $0$ | $2$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,4)$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ | $\frac{5}{8}$ |

Suppose $X$ and $Y$ are discrete random variables. Find $\text{Var}[X\,|\,Y=4]$ given that the conditional probability mass function ${f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,4)$ is shown in the table above and the corresponding conditional expected value is ${\mu }_{X|4}=3.$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional variance of $X$ given $Y=y$ is defined by

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[X\,|\,Y=y] & =\text{E}[(X-{\mu }_{X|y})^{2}\,|\,Y=y] \\  & =\text{E}[{X}^{2}\,|\,Y=y]-{\mu }_{X|y}^{2} \\  & =[{\sum }_{x}{x}^{2}\,{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,y)]-{\mu }_{X|y}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[X\,|\,Y=4] & =[{\sum }_{x}{x}^{2}\,{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,4)]-{\mu }_{X|4}^{2} \\  & =[(0)^{2}\cdot \frac{1}{8}+(2)^{2}\cdot \frac{1}{4}+(4)^{2}\cdot \frac{5}{8}]-(3)^{2} \\  & =0+1+10-9 \\  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$
